title: 英国进口VAT的付款时点
summary_zh: 符合条件的英国VAT登记企业可通过VAT申报处理进口VAT；安排他人报关时需要按指引发出书面指示。这是进口人的税务安排，不自动适用于中国卖方。
summary_en: Postponed VAT accounting allows eligible UK VAT-registered importers to declare and recover import VAT through the same return, subject to recovery rules. A representative needs written instructions before making the declaration.
anchor_terms: registered for VAT in the UK
tradex_workflow: Ask who is the importer and whether postponed accounting is arranged; request the instruction or statement before changing the cash scenario.
cash_effect: Separate VAT accounting from upfront cash payment and from customs duty; model only the exporter’s contractual exposure.
title_en: When UK import VAT becomes payable
source_title: Check when you can account for import VAT on your VAT Return
embedding_text:
英国进口VAT的付款时点
符合条件的英国VAT登记企业可通过VAT申报处理进口VAT；安排他人报关时需要按指引发出书面指示。这是进口人的税务安排，不自动适用于中国卖方。
Postponed VAT accounting allows eligible UK VAT-registered importers to declare and recover import VAT through the same return, subject to recovery rules. A representative needs written instructions before making the declaration.
Keywords: 英国, 进口VAT, 垫付税款, 现金流, PVA, postponed VAT
